title: Project
description: An ANVIL project registry entry — a known project with status and gate phase.

repo.description: GitHub repo in owner/repo format, or null if not yet on GitHub

notes.description: One-sentence context, open conflict, or blocker

removed_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp if project was removed from registry. Entries are never silently deleted.

removed_reason.description: Reason for removal, required if removed_at is set
